units.Description: Physical unit. The release stores int16 values without a scale factor to volts; written as n/a (BrainVision header: 'unscaled').

type.Description: SEEG is used for the intraoperative microelectrode channels (stereotactic depth recordings); BIDS has no microelectrode-specific type.

source_n_samples.Description: Number of samples of this channel in the release file. Channels of one file can differ in length; samples after source_n_samples are NaN in the BrainVision file.
